posts.title: How to make your automation survive reboots
posts.body:
How to make your automation survive reboots:

1. Create LaunchAgent plist file
2. Point to your scheduler script
3. Set RunAtLoad = true
4. Load with launchctl

Now your Mac restarts → automation resumes automatically.

No more "forgot to start the scheduler" moments.
